title: Jude and the Harbor
author: Ansel Eriksen
blurb: Orsen Delacroix, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
